note: Which mobs each damage skill hits (in the order of classes.json's skills), read by the game and the bot (web/town-mobs.ts). single: the target. chain:N: the target, then the nearest live mob within 3 tiles of the last one hit, N in all. cone:N / area:N: the target and the mobs nearest it within 2 tiles, N in all. around:N: the live mobs next to the caster (1 tile), up to N. line:N: the mobs along the line from the caster through the target (to 5 tiles), nearest first, up to N. The effects play the skill preview's script with the hit mobs in the slots it uses (combat/skill-slots.ts).

effects.note: What a skill does to each mob it hits besides damage, by class and skill: slow:F:MS (moves at F of its speed for MS ms), root:MS (can't move for MS ms; it still attacks next to you). null: nothing.
